articles.title: US delegation expected in Doha for direct Iran talks after reported breakthrough: Reports
articles.description: An American delegation is expected to join Iranian officials for direct talks in Doha following a reported breakthrough in indirect negotiations between Washington and Tehran, The Times of Israel reported, citing the Qatari newspaper Al-Araby Al-Jadeed.

articles.title: Israel’s Election Deadlock Opens the Door to Another Iran Offensive
articles.description: Israel’s inconclusive election leaves Netanyahu in power as coalition negotiations unfold amid growing indications of possible renewed U.S. military action against Iran.

articles.title: Israel deadlocked / Trump, Iran and the midterms
articles.description: A majority of Israeli voters went against sitting Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's bloc, but he may not have to cede his office. It's not clear the opposition will be able to form a governing coalition.Guest host Scott Detrow talks with NPR International Correspondent Daniel Estrin and NPR National Security Correspondent Greg Myre about how the election could affect Netanyahu's calculus on the war in Iran. U.S. President Donald Trump said that he and Netanyahu "have to finish the job that we started!"
